free_tier.stated: 180,000 vCPU-seconds and 360,000 GiB-seconds a month on Agent Engine, which is 50 vCPU-hours and 100 GiB-hours, recurring

limits.value: 180,000 vCPU-seconds and 360,000 GiB-seconds a month on Agent Engine
50 vCPU-hours a month is 6.8% of a 730-hour month, so a single always-on agent exceeds it

identity_cost.detail: a Google account, then a Cloud Billing account: the Free Tier states that a Cloud Billing account is needed, and the Free Trial signup states that a credit card or other payment method valid for the trial period must be provided. A Cloud Billing account must keep a valid payment method at all times and prepaid cards are not accepted; in many countries a debit card or a bank account is accepted as the primary method instead. The Google account signup asks for a username, a password, a birthday and gender, and adding and verifying a phone number is optional, so no phone number is required to open the account. Express mode of the same platform states that no billing information is needed, but its free tier covers only the model APIs that support express mode, not the agent runtime the allowance is spent on.
identity_cost.country: restricted in some countries and regions, such as China, Crimea, Cuba, Iran, North Korea and Syria; the country chosen on a Cloud Billing account cannot be changed later
